en.hubeali: Mhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ammar Bin Marwan who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who says, ‘I seek Forgiveness of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’, one hundred times during every day, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would Forgive seven hundred sins for him, and there is no good in a servant who sins during every day, seven hundred times’.
en.sarwar: 10. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn Sinan from ‘Ammar ibn Marwan who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘If one says, “I plead for forgiveness before Allah” one hundred times every day, Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, will forgive his seven hundred sins, but there is nothing good in a servant (of Allah) who commits seven hundred sins a day.’”
